title: Interview card
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Common vocabulary: prepositions, questions and body parts
source: Seeded from arabic/y7 lesson 28 (Pupil PDF worksheet: interview card)
intro: Lesson 28: Question words (1): مَا، مَاذَا، مَنْ. To understand the difference between مَا، مَاذَا and مَنْ and use each correctly

questions.q: Answer in full: مَاذَا تَكْتُبُ؟ (I am writing a letter)
questions.model: Teacher: تَكْتُبُ (you write) becomes أَكْتُبُ (I write); add the thing: رِسَالَةً.

questions.q: Interview card on the pupil PDF: write five questions (two with مَا, two with مَاذَا, one with مَنْ) for a partner; ask them in a breakout and write their full answers in Arabic.
questions.a: Correct choice of question word; full answers with the verb changed to 'I'
questions.model: Teacher asks a pupil: مَاذَا تُحِبُّ؟ Pupil: أُحِبُّ القِرَاءَةَ. Teacher writes both.

questions.q: ask who someone is in a family photo description (no photos of people needed): مَنْ ...؟
Back to our ponder: why two words for 'what?'
questions.a: مَا before nouns, مَاذَا before verbs
